title: Load the trace and one module, fetch the rest on demand
lesson: Retrieve the failing trace and the module it identifies, then follow dependencies revealed by inspection. Stale notes can steer a candidate edit; fewer tokens do not establish a speedup or a correct patch.
transcript: 0.0–4.8s: In this retrieval example, the null-crash task is present before the trace and all five repository files are loaded. The illustrative meter rises from 1k to 14k of 16k. High occupancy turns amber; the window is not exceeded.

5.4–11.9s: Context reaches the model, which pulses while working. At 7.3s the old notes row exposes old: edit db.ts. An amber db.ts? candidate leaves the model at 9.3s and lands at 9.8s. No test has run; the candidate reflects the stale note.
12.0–12.8s: The context is reset to the task alone and the previous candidate clears. The meter returns to 1k.
13.2–15.7s: The trace is loaded first; its api.ts module is selected and retrieved. The illustrated context settles at about 4k.
16.1–19.9s: After reading the partial context, the model requests users.ts?; the repository row lights and the file returns. The context grows to about 7k.

20.1–25.8s: Another model invocation emits the amber api.ts:42? candidate at 21.7–22.2s. The proposal holds until 24.7s, then the stage fades to the title-only opening. No latency number, test result or correctness tick appears.
limitations: This is a schematic contrast, not a recorded agent run. Stale evidence may mislead, but a large context can contain essential information and selective retrieval can miss it.
Token counts and the 16k window are illustrative. Runtime retrieval can add tool calls and latency; caching can reduce repeated-input processing cost. There is no measured speedup here.
Both output badges are candidate locations, not patches checked by a fixture. The trace alone does not prove the fault lies in the named file.
One follow-up retrieval is shown; real agents may need several and should preserve applicable constraints throughout.
Material placed in context informs the model; it does not enforce permissions. Authorization belongs in the harness and tools.
Audio was analyzed for peak, timing and spectral events, not heard.

corrections.change: Removed invented 41s/9s latency comparison and its colliding badge; paired work ticks with visible model pulses.
Changed high-but-within-capacity occupancy from red to amber; exposed the stale note content before its candidate edit.
Replaced untested failure/success verdicts with amber db.ts? and api.ts:42? candidates; kept the incremental retrieval mechanism.
Increased store row text from 26px to 32px and routed departing file chips clear of the Repository label; tightened the final ripple below the meter.
